title: A Friday night with a 1,000-piece puzzle
old_caption: 999 pieces down, one missing, full panic. Virgo found it in the last place anyone would look: under Virgo. What's your favourite quiet Friday?

title: Picked the restaurant in under a minute
old_caption: Libra picked dinner in under a minute. Nobody to ask, nobody to "you pick" with. Growth, or just hungry? Tag your indecisive friend.

title: Didn't check their story. Not once.
old_caption: 2 a.m., thumb hovering over their story. Scorpio put the phone face down and made tea instead. What's your 2 a.m. move?

title: Booked the solo trip at 1 a.m.
old_caption: Booked a solo trip at 1 a.m. Passengers: one. Seat: window. Which sign does this the most?

title: Did nothing on Friday, on purpose
old_caption: Capricorn put "nothing" in the calendar, then worried the nothing was behind schedule. Then fell asleep. When did you last do nothing on purpose?

title: A kitchen dance party for one
old_caption: Kitchen concert, wooden spoon mic, sock slide finale. The audience was zero people, one Pisces on video, and it was still a sellout.

title: Pisces named the houseplant
old_caption: One new leaf and Pisces is a parent now. Meet Mr. Leaf. He has a scarf. Who else talks to their plants?

title: “So, are you seeing anyone?”
old_caption: "So, are you seeing anyone?" Boss fight at the family dinner. Aries won with three words and a second helping of potatoes.

title: Third wheel, main character
old_caption: Third wheel? Leo took the couple's photo, then got pulled into the next one. Best seat on the bench. Who's your third-wheel legend?

title: Slept through the 2 a.m. “u up?”
old_caption: Three "u up?" texts at 2 a.m. Libra slept through every one, read them in the morning and moved on. Peaceful.
